description: Sentry crash reporting, error & performance monitoring SDK. Auto-initializes via ContentProviders and installs a global uncaught-exception handler; Exodus classifies it as a tracker (exfiltrates device + usage data).

methods.name: init
methods.note: Android manual init entry (Context[, ILogger][, OptionsConfiguration<SentryAndroidOptions>]) — void; delegates to Sentry.init. Stubbing prevents SDK bootstrap.

methods.name: init
methods.note: Facade init (all overloads void). Primary neutralization: without init the SDK stays a NoOp hub, so capture* below become inert and return SentryId.EMPTY_ID.

methods.name: captureException
methods.note: Returns io.sentry.protocol.SentryId. Stubbed to null (send suppressed). The event id return value is almost never dereferenced by callers; see report for residual risk.

manifest_components.note: Auto-init ContentProvider — bootstraps Sentry with no app call. Must be disabled or the SDK starts regardless of the init stub.
Auto-init ContentProvider — records app-start/performance and starts SDK plumbing before Application.onCreate.
